test that reads one is that day's request (the day's run then skips it).

200.description: Server-sent events: `event: {type}` / `data: {type, payload, ts}`, plus `: ping` comments every 15 s.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: "; "-joined flags and node errors, e.g. "llm_disabled". For non-analysts the node errors are folded into one "stage_errors" flag (they can quote model output).

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the run failed; for non-analysts only the error's class name.

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.description: The run's funnel counts so far: written after every stage while the run is going and final once it finishes; null before the first stage.

briefing_date.title: Briefing Date
briefing_date.description: The local date of the briefing this run filed (read it at /briefings/{date}); null when the run filed none.

args.title: Args
args.description: The call's arguments, for analysts only: null for every other role.

result_summary.title: Result Summary
result_summary.description: What the step returned, for analysts only: null for every other role (results quote signal titles and facts whatever their status).

status.title: Status
status.description: How the step ended, for every role: an error, a model refusal, or a stop at the LLM budget.

error_kind.title: Error Kind
error_kind.description: The error's class name (e.g. LLMError) when status is error and it is known; else null.

board_since.title: Board Since
board_since.description: Its board's first snapshot day, the day it was first listed in full: its line starts here. Always set, as only boards listed in full are read.

last_listed.title: Last Listed
last_listed.description: Its board's latest complete listing day.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Not listed in full for board_stale_days (3) days, so it is not counted in the series (as if it had no board).

min_signals.title: Min Signals
min_signals.description: Public signals in lookback_days a weekly brief needs (else none yet).

edition.title: Edition
edition.description: The edition of the row served: the requested one, or master when the date has none.

requested_edition.title: Requested Edition
requested_edition.description: The reader's own edition (their role's; master for analysts). When it differs from `edition`, the date has no such edition and its master is shown ("Showing Master").

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.description: The day's run counts, summed over the runs that filed this date (fetched, documents_created, prefilter_passed, triaged, relevant, signals_new, signals_analyzed, signals_deep_analyzed, postings_tagged, page_changes, facts_extracted, signals_breaking), plus briefing_status and runs (how many runs were summed); {} when the briefing has no run counts.

edition.title: Edition
edition.description: The edition of the row served: the requested one, or master when the date has none.

requested_edition.title: Requested Edition
requested_edition.description: The reader's own edition (their role's; master for analysts). When it differs from `edition`, the date has no such edition and its master is shown ("Showing Master").

n.title: N
n.description: 1-based source number; analysis `cites` refer to it.

url.title: Url
url.description: Null for a cited signal the reader may not see.

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: GitHub stars/forks per day over 180 days.

mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.description: Relevant Hacker News items about it per week: up to 13 weeks, from the week holding collected_since; empty when no Hacker News search runs for it.

their_products.title: Their Products
their_products.description: Its seeded products countering the JFrog product (seed order); empty when only its signals name the product.

threat_level.title: Threat Level
threat_level.description: The overlap level of threat_weight (high from 6, medium from 3, low from 1).

threat_weight.title: Threat Weight
threat_weight.description: Severity-weighted threat impacts naming the product, 180 days.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Severity-weighted impacts of any effect naming it.

last_move.description: Its newest signal naming the product (any effect) in 180 days.

threat_signals.title: Threat Signals
threat_signals.description: The signals threat_weight is summed from, newest first.

CompareCellOut.title: CompareCellOut
CompareCellOut.description:
One JFrog product against one competitor (a column): its seeded products countering
the product and the evidence-based threat to it, as the product page's Competitors table
computes them. A pair is served when a product is seeded for it or its signals name the
product; any other pair has no cell.

threat.description: Its overall threat to JFrog, as the overview's.

product_categories.title: Product Categories
product_categories.description: The categories of its seeded products, seed order (the category filter).

CompareCompetitorOut.title: CompareCompetitorOut
CompareCompetitorOut.description:
A column: a competitor with at least one seeded product, by tier, then threat (high
first, then score), then name.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: What it adds to the cell's threat weight (high 3 ...).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: The highest severity it names: high, medium or low.

CompareEvidenceOut.title: CompareEvidenceOut
CompareEvidenceOut.description: A signal whose current analysis names the JFrog product as threatened.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The local day the matrix is computed for.

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: The threat window, in days ending as_of.

collected_since.title: Collected Since
collected_since.description: The local day FrogEye filed its first document; null before any.

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: Row by row (products order), then by column (competitors order).

CompareProductOut.title: CompareProductOut
CompareProductOut.description:
A row: one JFrog product, in JFROG_PRODUCTS order, with its pressure as GET /products
serves it.

url.title: Url
url.description: The vendor's own public page for it (the seed's).

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When it was written: the brief's "as of".

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Sources it was written from, by ref kind.

CompetitorBriefOut.title: CompetitorBriefOut
CompetitorBriefOut.description: The current "bottom line for JFrog" with its numbered sources.

CompetitorHeaderOut.title: CompetitorHeaderOut
CompetitorHeaderOut.description:
No logo is served: a third-party logo would make readers' browsers request
other hosts.

open_roles.title: Open Roles
open_roles.description: Open roles on its current job board(s) as of their last complete listing (as_of); null until an enabled board has been listed in full (a board found but not yet listed, or only listed in part, is pending) and null for a stale board, not listed in full for board_stale_days (3) days: open_roles_note / the hiring coverage note says which.

delta_30d.title: Delta 30D
delta_30d.description: Open roles on the as-of day minus 30 days before it; null until an enabled board has been listed in full, for a stale board (as open roles), or before the board has 30 days of history (board_since).

brief.description: Null: see the overview coverage note.

momentum.title: Momentum
momentum.description: Up to 13 weeks, from the week holding collected_since; null when the threat is insufficient.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: 180 days of visible signals, oldest first.

latest_signals.title: Latest Signals
latest_signals.description: Its 20 newest public signals the reader may see (the same for everyone).

collected_since.title: Collected Since
collected_since.description: The local day FrogEye filed its first document: weekly series start at the week holding it, and a trend needs its 9 baseline weeks collected after it; null before any document.

CompetitorProfile.title: CompetitorProfile
CompetitorProfile.description:
GET /competitors/{slug}/profile: the deep dive, identical for every persona. Its signal cards
(latest_signals, customers.signals, people_partners.signals) and the brief's cited signals are
its public signals (status auto|approved, never JFrog scope) that the reader may also see, the
same rule as the product page. Every empty
section has a coverage note in `sources_freshness.notes` saying why.

jfrog_products.title: Jfrog Products
jfrog_products.description: JFrog products its seeded products compete with (JFROG_PRODUCTS order).

product_categories.title: Product Categories
product_categories.description: The categories of its seeded products (ProductOverlapOut.category), each once, in seed order: the competitor list's category filter.

momentum.title: Momentum
momentum.description: Up to 13 weekly importance sums, oldest first, from the week holding the collected-since day (no week before collection began); null when the threat is insufficient (never thirteen zeros).

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: The threat's overlap driver; null if insufficient.

open_roles.title: Open Roles
open_roles.description: Open roles on its current job board(s) as of their last complete listing (as_of); null until an enabled board has been listed in full (a board found but not yet listed, or only listed in part, is pending) and null for a stale board, not listed in full for board_stale_days (3) days: open_roles_note / the hiring coverage note says which.

delta_30d.title: Delta 30D
delta_30d.description: Open roles on the as-of day minus 30 days before it; null until an enabled board has been listed in full, for a stale board (as open roles), or before the board has 30 days of history (board_since).

open_roles_as_of.title: Open Roles As Of
open_roles_as_of.description: When the counts were read: the last complete listing of its job board(s) (the oldest, with several), usually today's run, yesterday's before it; null when no count is served.

board_since.title: Board Since
board_since.description: The board's first snapshot day: the day its current board was first listed in full; every hiring series starts here. Null until an enabled board has been listed in full.

board_checked_at.title: Board Checked At
board_checked_at.description: Without a board, the last time job-board discovery (an operator command; a miss is cached for 30 days) checked Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby and found none; null when it never recorded a check, or when a board is found.

board_state.title: Board State
board_state.description: Why open_roles is (or is not) served: measured; pending (a board found, not listed in full yet); stale (not listed in full for board_stale_days); none (no board found).

open_roles_note.title: Open Roles Note
open_roles_note.description: Why open_roles is null: "No public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board found" (with " (checked <day>)" when discovery recorded one), "Job board found — first snapshot pending" or "Job board not readable since <day>"; null when open_roles is measured.

funding_total.description: Null when no funding round states an amount.

CompetitorSummary.title: CompetitorSummary
CompetitorSummary.description: One row of GET /competitors/overview (JFrog itself is never listed).

today_usd.title: Today Usd
today_usd.description: Spend in the current local (settings.timezone) day.

last_7_days.title: Last 7 Days
last_7_days.description: Local days, oldest first, ending today.

text.title: Text
text.description: Why the section is empty or partial, said plainly ("No public job board found", "Job board found — first snapshot pending").

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: Named customers and customer counts, newest first.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Public customer win/loss signals the reader may see, newest first.

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: When the demo data this database started from was captured; null when the database did not start from the bundled demo snapshot.

live_usd.title: Live Usd
live_usd.description: Spent by this run on live calls (its ledger).

recorded_usd.title: Recorded Usd
recorded_usd.description: What the recorded calls this run replayed cost when they were recorded.

EvalGroup.title: EvalGroup
EvalGroup.description: A breakdown row: a retrieval mode, a guardrail attack type, a triage case kind.

value.title: Value
value.description: None when no scored case can compute it.

numerator.title: Numerator
numerator.description: For a rate: the cases counted.

denominator.title: Denominator
denominator.description: For a rate: the cases it is over.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the suite measures and why.

label_source.title: Label Source
label_source.description: Who made the labels the suite scores against.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Cases with a model call missing from the recordings.

failures.title: Failures
failures.description: Every scored case the app got wrong.

recorded_at.title: Recorded At
recorded_at.description: When the recordings were last extended.

stale_cases.title: Stale Cases
stale_cases.description: Cases left unscored across suites (not recorded).

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Null: an undated fact, never on a time axis.

FactOut.title: FactOut
FactOut.description:
A fact grouped by (kind, label, as-of month) over its sources: the value is
the newest source's that states one; `sources` lists every source, newest first.

sources_disagree.title: Sources Disagree
sources_disagree.description: Its fact's sources state different values.

FactPointOut.title: FactPointOut
FactPointOut.description:
A reported figure on a time axis: one point per distinct value of a dated fact, so two
sources that disagree are two points, never an average.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: The verified quote, as the source writes it.

published_at.title: Published At
published_at.description: When the source was published (an article) or fetched (a page).

FactSourceOut.title: FactSourceOut
FactSourceOut.description: One source's statement of a fact (facts are never averaged).

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Null: the amount was not disclosed.

FundingRoundOut.title: FundingRoundOut
FundingRoundOut.description: One dated funding round (a fact group); the amount is its newest source's.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO code; the currency most rounds state.

undated_rounds.title: Undated Rounds
undated_rounds.description: Of those, rounds no source dates (not among money.funding_rounds, which are dated; they are in money.undated): "incl. N undated".

excluded_rounds.title: Excluded Rounds
excluded_rounds.description: Rounds not in the sum: no amount stated, or another currency.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The newest dated round in the sum: how current the total is; null when every round in it is undated.

FundingTotalOut.title: FundingTotalOut
FundingTotalOut.description:
The sum of the funding rounds that state an amount, in one currency. A named round
(seed, "Series B") is one round across the months its sources date it to, within 120 days
of its earliest source (two "seed" rounds years apart are two).

points.title: Points
points.description: Reported figures only, oldest first: no line is drawn between them.

sources_disagree.title: Sources Disagree
sources_disagree.description: Its fact's sources state different values.

layoff.title: Layoff
layoff.description: A layoff marker (value: the number or % cut, if stated).

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Capability slugs mapped to its KB page.

boards.title: Boards
boards.description: The competitors' job boards (each listed in full), by first snapshot, then slug; a stale one is listed but not counted.

total.title: Total
total.description: Each posting once, from the earliest board's first snapshot to the last day every board counted was listed in full; empty without a board or a capability.

by_competitor.title: By Competitor
by_competitor.description: Every competitor with an area posting in the window, each from its board's first snapshot; no server-side Other (the chart folds on the client).

HiringAreaOut.title: HiringAreaOut
HiringAreaOut.description:
Competitor postings tagged with the product's capabilities, over 90 days, from the
competitors whose enabled job board has been listed in full (JFrog never). Each competitor's
line starts at its board's first snapshot and the total at the earliest board's: no day before a
board was read is drawn, let alone as zero.

open_now.title: Open Now
open_now.description: Open roles on its current job board(s) as of their last complete listing (as_of); null until an enabled board has been listed in full (a board found but not yet listed, or only listed in part, is pending) and null for a stale board, not listed in full for board_stale_days (3) days: open_roles_note / the hiring coverage note says which.

delta_30d.title: Delta 30D
delta_30d.description: Open roles on the as-of day minus 30 days before it; null until an enabled board has been listed in full, for a stale board (as open roles), or before the board has 30 days of history (board_since).

board_since.title: Board Since
board_since.description: The board's first snapshot day: the day its current board was first listed in full; every hiring series starts here. Null until an enabled board has been listed in full.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: When the counts were read: the last complete listing of its job board(s) (the oldest, with several), usually today's run, yesterday's before it; null when no count is served.

not_readable_since.title: Not Readable Since
not_readable_since.description: A stale board's last complete listing day (no current count is served; its series end there); null otherwise.

board_checked_at.title: Board Checked At
board_checked_at.description: Without a board, the last time job-board discovery (an operator command; a miss is cached for 30 days) checked Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby and found none; null when it never recorded a check, or when a board is found.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags on the open postings that are tagged: a share of the board when tag_coverage has pending or given-up postings.

tag_coverage.description: The open postings by tagging state; null when open_now is.

HiringSeriesOut.title: HiringSeriesOut
HiringSeriesOut.description:
Open roles per day over 90 days, or from the board's first snapshot (`board_since`)
when that is later, never zero-filled before it, to the board's last complete
listing (a stale board's history ends there); empty until an enabled board has
been listed in full. Every key has a point on every day of that window; location
keeps its top 8 keys plus "Other"; a posting counts once per tag and untagged postings
are absent from `tag`.

collected_since.title: Collected Since
collected_since.description: The local day FrogEye filed its first document: weekly series start at the week holding it, never drawn as quiet weeks before it; null before any document.

IntelReferenceOut.title: IntelReferenceOut
IntelReferenceOut.description:
GET /intel-reference: the lists and thresholds the competitor and product pages quote
("How this is computed", trend words), served from the backend's own constants and
settings so the pages keep no copies, plus the day FrogEye began
collecting.

n.title: N
n.description: 1-based source number; the brief's `cites` refer to it.

title.title: Title
title.description: "Signal not available" for a signal the reader may not see.

url.title: Url
url.description: /signals/<id> for a signal (null when not visible); the article, page or posting URL otherwise.

day.title: Day
day.description: A signal's day, a fact's as-of date, a posting's first-seen day, a page change's day.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: A fact's verified quote; a page change's summary.

IntelSourceOut.title: IntelSourceOut
IntelSourceOut.description: One numbered source of a brief.

KitOut.title: KitOut
KitOut.description: A key intelligence topic (KIT): `title` is its short name, `question` the full ask.

peers.title: Peers
peers.description: The 4 competitors sharing the most JFrog counterparts with it (ties: the closest tier, then slug); never JFrog.

share_of_voice.title: Share Of Voice
share_of_voice.description: Up to 13 weeks for it and each peer, from the week holding the collected-since day: relevant documents and visible signals.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: Revenue and ARR points, oldest first.

undated.title: Undated
undated.description: Undated rounds, valuations, revenue and ARR.

high_evidence.title: High Evidence
high_evidence.description: Evidence from which the level is high.

medium_evidence.title: Medium Evidence
medium_evidence.description: Evidence from which it is medium (low from 1).

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: Days of public signals the evidence counts.

OverlapRulesOut.title: OverlapRulesOut
OverlapRulesOut.description: A seeded product's overlap level from its evidence (weighted jfrog_impact entries).

diff.title: Diff
diff.description: The stored diff's first whole lines, at most 4,000 characters (changed lines with their context); the whole of it at GET /competitors/{slug}/page-changes/{snapshot_id}/diff when `truncated`.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: The diff served is the start of a longer one.

PageChangeOut.title: PageChangeOut
PageChangeOut.description:
A meaningful change to a watched pricing page (or one judged a pricing/packaging
change on another page), with its diff ("-" removed, "+" added).

diff.title: Diff
diff.description: The unified diff ("-" removed, "+" added), as stored.

PageDiffOut.title: PageDiffOut
PageDiffOut.description: The whole stored diff of one page change.

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: Leadership changes, acquisitions, partnerships and offices, newest first.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Public leadership, acquisition and partnership signals the reader may see, newest first.

closed_at.title: Closed At
closed_at.description: Null while the posting is open.

tag_state.title: Tag State
tag_state.description: The tagging state: "tagged" (tags found); "untagged" (tagged, and it names no product area: the explicit untagged state); "pending" (not tagged yet); "gave_up" (tagging failed on 3 days, not asked again until the posting changes).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor; null on the last page.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When it was written: the brief's "as of".

threat_level.title: Threat Level
threat_level.description: From its threat impacts in 180 days.

ProductImpactRef.title: ProductImpactRef
ProductImpactRef.description: A JFrog product the story affects, as the analysis's jfrog_impact rates it.

signal_ids.title: Signal Ids
signal_ids.description: The analysed signals it is built from, newest first.

edges.title: Edges
edges.description: The brief's edges for this product.

ProductOverlapOut.title: ProductOverlapOut
ProductOverlapOut.description: A seeded product vs its JFrog counterparts, with evidence-based overlap.

description.title: Description
description.description: From the JFrog context pack's portfolio.

pressure_series.title: Pressure Series
pressure_series.description: Up to 13 weeks, oldest first, from the week holding collected_since; empty when no signal names the product.

collected_since.title: Collected Since
collected_since.description: The local day FrogEye filed its first document: weekly series start at the week holding it, and a trend needs its 9 baseline weeks collected after it; null before any document.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: 180 days of visible signals naming it, oldest first.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Its 30 newest public signals the reader may see (the same for everyone).

ProductProfile.title: ProductProfile
ProductProfile.description:
GET /products/{slug}: no JFrog company figures anywhere; identical for every
persona. Its signal cards and the brief's cited signals are the product's
public signals (status auto|approved, never JFrog scope) that the reader may also see,
the same rule as the competitor deep dive.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Kebab-case of the name ("JFrog ML" is "jfrog-ml").

description.title: Description
description.description: What it does, from the JFrog context pack's portfolio (capabilities only).

pressure.title: Pressure
pressure.description: Threat pressure over 90 days: the last 4 weeks vs the 9 before. A trend only when pressure_baseline is true; otherwise threat in the collected weeks reads "rising" as new pressure, and the page says there is no baseline yet, never "rising".

pressure_baseline.title: Pressure Baseline
pressure_baseline.description: Whether the 9 weeks the pressure compares with were all collected and hold threat (as the momentum trend): false while FrogEye has collected for under 13 weeks, or when those 9 weeks name no threat.

top_competitors.title: Top Competitors
top_competitors.description: Up to 3 competitor slugs, by evidence, then tier, then slug.

competitor_slug.title: Competitor Slug
competitor_slug.description: The swimlane: one event per competitor it names.

RoleAction.title: RoleAction
RoleAction.description: One recommended action, copied from the analysis (or stage A), with its role.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: What this role should do; null when never written and may be "" -- hide if empty.

pm.title: Pm
pm.description: What this role should do; null when never written and may be "" -- hide if empty.

exec.title: Exec
exec.description: What this role should do; null when never written and may be "" -- hide if empty.

pmm_devrel.title: Pmm Devrel
pmm_devrel.description: What this role should do; null when never written and may be "" -- hide if empty.

RoleActions.title: RoleActions
RoleActions.description: Per-role action lines from the analyst agent. Any value may be null or "".

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'full' (default) queues the Daily Intelligence graph; 'ingest' queues ingestion only. Without OPENAI_API_KEY a full run only ingests.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'full' for a Daily Intelligence run (kind 'daily': ingest, then triage, analysis and the briefing), 'ingest' for an ingestion-only run.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: The run's counts, written as it goes. Ingestion: sources_attempted, sources_failed, sources_skipped_today (job boards and watched pages already fetched that local day: each is read at most once a day), fetched, new_raw, metrics_written, documents_created, prefilter_passed, and the job boards' postings_new (first seen) and postings_closed (no longer listed by a complete listing). A full run adds its funnel: triaged, relevant, signals_new, signals_analyzed, signals_deep_analyzed, postings_tagged, page_changes (meaningful page changes filed as documents), facts_extracted, signals_breaking and briefing_status; and `errors` when a stage failed. A count is absent when the run stopped before its stage.

agent_run_id.title: Agent Run Id
agent_run_id.description: The agent run that traces a full run's graph (its steps, tokens and cost). Null for ingest-only runs.

active.title: Active
active.description: True while a worker is executing this run (it is 'running' and the ingestion lock is held). A 'running' run that is not active was interrupted: its worker stopped before finishing, and the next run marks it failed.

RunQueued.title: RunQueued
RunQueued.description:
The job is queued; the worker records its pipeline run (and, for a full run, its
agent run) when it starts. GET /runs lists them (RunOut.agent_run_id).

search_mode.title: Search Mode
search_mode.description: "keyword" when no query embedding could be had (no OpenAI key, an embedding error or the LLM budget): the hits match the words, not the meaning.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The analysis summary (rows show its first sentence); "" on older ones.

from_analysis.title: From Analysis
from_analysis.description: True when the body is copied from the signal's current stage-B analysis; false when it is the stage-A fact and impact (mark it) and on briefings filed before.

SeverityWeightsOut.title: SeverityWeightsOut
SeverityWeightsOut.description: The weight of a jfrog_impact entry by its severity (overlap, threat and pressure).

SignalAnalysisOut.title: SignalAnalysisOut
SignalAnalysisOut.description: `SignalAnalysisContent` with every `cites` turned into source numbers.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Admiralty source reliability, A (best) to F.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: reliability + credibility, e.g. "B2"; null if unscored.

primary_url.title: Primary Url
primary_url.description: Original URL of the primary source document.

primary_source.title: Primary Source
primary_source.description: Name of the primary document's source.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The latest analysis summary (current or stale); null when none.

analysis_state.title: Analysis State
analysis_state.description: The full analysis, with its reason when there is none: "current"; "stale" (the story has new coverage since; still shown in full); "pending" (eligible, not written yet); "thin" (headline-only or too-short evidence: none will be written); "below_threshold" (importance under the stage-B floor: none will be written).

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Admiralty source reliability, A (best) to F.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: reliability + credibility, e.g. "B2"; null if unscored.

primary_url.title: Primary Url
primary_url.description: Original URL of the primary source document.

primary_source.title: Primary Source
primary_source.description: Name of the primary document's source.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The latest analysis summary (current or stale); null when none.

analysis_state.title: Analysis State
analysis_state.description: The full analysis, with its reason when there is none: "current"; "stale" (the story has new coverage since; still shown in full); "pending" (eligible, not written yet); "thin" (headline-only or too-short evidence: none will be written); "below_threshold" (importance under the stage-B floor: none will be written).

score_breakdown.title: Score Breakdown
score_breakdown.description: Scoring components (value/weight/contribution), decay, age_days, evidence_depth ({thin, multiplier}: headline-only sources are scored x0.6) and importance, plus any verification/error notes.

related.title: Related
related.description: Up to 5 most similar visible signals.

analysis.description: The latest parseable stage-B analysis, or null (fall back to fact/impact).

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Numbered sources: all member documents, then cited KB docs and signals.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor; always null with q.

search_mode.title: Search Mode
search_mode.description: How q was searched: "keyword" when no embedding was available (no OpenAI key, or embedding failed / over budget); null without q.

item_count.title: Item Count
item_count.description: What the fetch returned, in the source's own unit: feed or search items; a job board's postings (postings_count); 1 for a watched page whose text was read (page_text_chars); a repository's metric readings (metrics_count).

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: The first 5 items, a job board's first 5 postings (published_at: the ATS's posting date, if it gives one), or the watched page itself.

postings_count.title: Postings Count
postings_count.description: Job boards: the postings the listing holds; null for other kinds.

postings_complete.title: Postings Complete
postings_complete.description: Job boards: whether the listing was the whole board. A partial one (a page short of its stated total) stores postings but measures nothing; null for other kinds.

page_text_chars.title: Page Text Chars
page_text_chars.description: Page watch: characters of main text read from the page; null for other kinds.

metrics_count.title: Metrics Count
metrics_count.description: Metric sources (GitHub repository stats): the readings taken (stars and forks; item_count says the same), never items; null for other kinds.

SourceTestOut.title: SourceTestOut
SourceTestOut.description: A dry run of one source's collector (nothing is stored).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: At least one per empty section (none for a section with data), in section order.

delta_30d.title: Delta 30D
delta_30d.description: Its open roles now minus 30 days ago; null before the board has 30 days of history.

TagCoverageOut.title: TagCoverageOut
TagCoverageOut.description: The open postings by tagging state: the tag counts are a share of `tagged`.

so_what.title: So What
so_what.description: Legacy body of briefings filed before `summary` existed; "" on newer ones -- show it only when `summary` is empty.

now_what.title: Now What
now_what.description: Legacy action of older briefings; may be "" -- show it (as one action) only when `actions` is empty, and hide the line when empty.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The card body: the analysis summary, verbatim.

why_it_matters.title: Why It Matters
why_it_matters.description: Why it matters, from the source `angle` names; may be "" -- hide the line when empty.

products.title: Products
products.description: The JFrog products the story affects.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Up to 3: the edition role's own actions (less the one `why_it_matters` shows), or on the master the first action of each role that has one.

from_analysis.title: From Analysis
from_analysis.description: True when the body is copied from the signal's current stage-B analysis; false when it is the stage-A fact and impact (mark it) and on briefings filed before.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: Where `why_it_matters` comes from, and its label: jfrog = the JFrog product impact ("Why it matters for JFrog": the master, older briefings, and an edition card whose analysis has no line for the role); sales = the first objection or talk-track line ("In your deals"); pm = the first assessment ("Product angle"); exec = the first implication ("Strategic angle"); pmm_devrel = the first messaging line ("Messaging angle"). An edition card without an analysis shows its stage-A line for the role, under that role's label.

risk_level.title: Risk Level
risk_level.description: Exec edition cards: the analysis's risk level; null hides the chip ("Risk: high").

level.title: Level
level.description: "insufficient": too few public signals and no job board listed in full.

score.title: Score
score.description: overlap x momentum factor x hiring factor.

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: Severity-weighted threat impacts on JFrog products in 180 days.

momentum_trend.title: Momentum Trend
momentum_trend.description: Last 4 weeks' mean weekly importance over the 9 weeks before; null with no baseline yet (those 9 weeks empty, or not all collected: collected_since) or when insufficient.

hiring_trend.title: Hiring Trend
hiring_trend.description: Open-roles change over 30 days as a ratio; null without a job board listed in full, or under 30 days of board history.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Every driver with its number, in words.

ThreatOut.title: ThreatOut
ThreatOut.description: The deterministic threat level and its drivers ("How this is computed").

high_score.title: High Score
high_score.description: Score from which the threat is high.

medium_score.title: Medium Score
medium_score.description: Score from which it is medium (else low).

min_signals.title: Min Signals
min_signals.description: Fewer public signals than this in lookback_days and no job board listed in full: insufficient data.

hiring_factor_bound.title: Hiring Factor Bound
hiring_factor_bound.description: The hiring factor stays within 1 ± this.

hiring_history_days.title: Hiring History Days
hiring_history_days.description: Days of board history a 30-day change needs (board_since).

ThreatRulesOut.title: ThreatRulesOut
ThreatRulesOut.description:
score = overlap x clamp(momentum_trend, factor min, max) x (1 + clamp(hiring_trend,
-bound, +bound)); each factor is 1.0 when its trend is null.

TimelineEventOut.title: TimelineEventOut
TimelineEventOut.description: A visible signal on the swimlane; its analysis is at /signals/{signal_id}.

weeks.title: Weeks
weeks.description: Weeks a weekly series spans (whole 7-day windows).

TrendRulesOut.title: TrendRulesOut
TrendRulesOut.description:
A weekly trend (a competitor's momentum_trend, a product's pressure): the mean of the
last `recent_weeks` over the mean of the `baseline_weeks` before, at most `cap`; rising
from `rising_ratio`, easing at or under `easing_ratio`, else steady. It needs a full
baseline after `collected_since`, else there is no baseline yet.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The app's time zone (settings TIMEZONE, an IANA name): the UI shows every date and time in it, so the day matches the briefing's and the budget's.

threat.title: Threat
threat.description: Severity-weighted threat impacts naming the product.
